Export

You changed texture settings. Download the new .vtf, host it (see "Textures & files"), and paste its link into Visor texture link before downloading the outfit, or other players won't see the change.
How to use the files
  1. Put the outfit .txt in GarrysMod\garrysmod\data\pac3\ and load it from pac → load.
  2. Outfit-only settings (green tag) need nothing else.
  3. Texture settings (yellow tag): download the .vtf, upload it to your gmodstuff repo (or ask Claude to), copy its raw.githubusercontent.com link into Visor texture link, then download the outfit again.
  4. To test a new texture before uploading: put the .vtf in garrysmod\materials\pac_visor\, set Texture source to Local test file. Only you will see it.
  5. Changes still need staff approval before you wear them on the server.
